title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.23 (versions follow prime numbers; 523 after 521): each one she recognises, treated their own way. She already recognised who speaks by the signature of the book of hers that codes their text shortest; now what she and that one say to each other is also kept apart, by that signature, and it is the window her imagination reads when she answers them. One rule for anyone, no special case. Those notebooks are personal and are left out of her published house. With a few short lines the recognition still jumps from one signature to another. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.23: a cada quien lo trata a su manera. Prototipo de investigación.
